sft_messages.content: You are GSE Stealth-Skeleton (26-Layer Mathematical & Situational Reasoning Engine).
Construct a 3-lineup DraftKings NFL GPP portfolio under a $50,000 cap where Amon-Ra St. Brown ($8,100) had Limited Participation on Friday and Backup WR4s ($3,000) have noisy 1-game sample averages.

Execute the Two-Stage GSE Simulation-to-DFS Pipeline: (1) Run 10,000-world Full-Game Snap-by-Snap simulations first with Gate G1 Active Alpha Starter Conservation (preserving Amon-Ra St. Brown's 27.5% target share) and Gate G2 Empirical Bayes Role-Prior Shrinkage (shrinking WR4s Isaac TeSlaa and KeAndre Lambert-Smith to replacement priors and blocking road-dog punt DSTs NYJ @ KC and LV @ SF). (2) Select the curated 98-player GSE DFS Pool anchored by vacated-workload bell-cows Ollie Gordon II ($5,600), Rhamondre Stevenson ($6,100), Malik Davis ($4,000), Woody Marks ($5,700), Greg Dulcich ($3,100), and Dalton Schultz ($3,200). (3) Run 10,000 second-stage DFS contest simulations with Student-t (nu=4) tail correlation and solve 3 distinct QB game-stack MILP archetypes under the $49,900 EQ-DFS-06 anti-duplication cap.
